description.en: Assertions for the inheritance rules: selector extraction (inline values, several conditions), which commands inherit (mouse and key) and which deliberately do not (waitfor, waitgone, window list).

description.zh: 目标继承规则的断言集。
description.en: Assertions for the inheritance rules.

description.zh: 循环结构分析的断言集：配对、命名、嵌套相乘、repeat 0 跳过、展开计数、超限拒绝、影子变量报错。它护着“结构不合法就在动手前停下”这条不变量。
description.en: Assertions for loop analysis: pairing, naming, nested multiplication, repeat 0 skipping the body, expansion counts, refusing an oversized expansion and refusing a shadowed variable.

description.zh: 循环结构与展开计数的断言集。
description.en: Assertions for loop structure and expansion counts.

description.zh: 全局选项提取（含 --flag=value、选择器拼装、悬空值报错）、各命令自己的选项，以及按键名映射（含 vk: 逃生口与未知键报错）。
description.en: Global option extraction (inline values, selector assembly, a dangling value being an error), per-command options, and the key-name map including the vk: hatch.

description.zh: 选项解析与按键名的断言集。
description.en: Assertions for option parsing and key names.

name.zh: 脚本选项、变量与重试用例

description.zh: run 的选项解析、${} 替换与预校验（未定义、未闭合、同一 token 多次引用），以及“只有 3/4/5 可重试”这条安全规则。
description.en: run's option parsing, ${} substitution and its upfront check (undefined, unterminated, repeated in one token), and the rule that only 3/4/5 may be retried.

description.zh: 脚本选项、变量与重试策略的断言集。
description.en: Assertions for script options, variables and retry policy.

description.zh: 注入一个假的派发器并数它被调用的次数：循环展开后 5 条命令就是 5 次调用，且派发器从未看到 repeat/end。如果哪天有人改成“每行起一个进程”，这个委托根本不会被调到，用例立刻变红。
description.en: Injects a fake dispatcher and counts the calls: five expanded commands mean five calls, and the dispatcher never sees repeat/end. If anyone ever made it spawn a process per line, this delegate would never be called.

description.zh: 单进程执行的回归保护。
description.en: Regression cover for single-process execution.

description.zh: 引号、转义、行内注释、KeyMouse 前缀容忍、行号保留——脚本语法那一层的行为断言。
description.en: Quotes, escapes, trailing comments, tolerating a copied KeyMouse prefix, keeping line numbers: the behaviour of the script-syntax layer.

description.zh: 分词器与行处理的断言集。
description.en: Assertions for the tokeniser and line handling.

description.zh: 不需要桌面的那一半：--rect 的解析与拒绝、坐标系判定的边界（正好等于客户区、比客户区宽一像素、跨出窗口、整屏选区），以及建议命令的文本。浮层本身要人（或模拟输入），在冒烟里测。
description.en: The half that needs no desktop: parsing and rejecting --rect, the boundaries of the space rule (exactly the client area, one pixel wider, crossing the window, a whole-screen selection), and the text of the suggested command. The overlay itself needs a human or simulated input and lives in smoke.

description.zh: --rect 解析与坐标系判定。
description.en: --rect parsing and the space rule.

description.zh: 不需要桌面的那一半：请求/事件形状、未知方法给退出码 2、validate 报步数、dry-run 逐步上报且日志流回来、真实（非 dry）运行被取消后退出码必须是 7，以及**真命名管道**上的往返（用私有管道名，绝不碰用户正开着的引擎）。
description.en: The half that needs no desktop: request/event shapes, an unknown method answering with exit code 2, validate reporting the step count, a dry run reporting every step with the log stream coming back, a real (not dry) run cancelled ending in exit code 7, and a round trip over a real named pipe (private pipe name, never the engine the user has open).

apis.path: Runner 协议与作业控制断言组

description.zh: 请求/事件、取消语义、管道往返。
description.en: Requests/events, cancel semantics, pipe round trips.

apis.key: rpc:Runner 协议与作业控制断言组

description.zh: 选择器匹配、候选收敛、状态串与闸门判定这些纯函数的断言；状态串用中文 token（可见/隐藏/未探测/无响应/已禁用），测的是“未探测”与“无响应”不被混为一谈。
description.en: Assertions for the pure window functions: selector matching, candidate preference, state text and gate verdicts, including that not-probed and no-answer stay distinct.

description.zh: 跑完所有窗口纯函数用例。
description.en: Runs every window-function case.

description.zh: 回答「这个窗口能不能安全地接收输入」：枚举顶层窗口 → 按选择器匹配 → 可见/最小化/遮盖/禁用/无响应逐项判定 → 聚焦并回读真实前台窗口确认。全部判定都是客观 API 查询，不含启发式猜测。
description.en: Answers whether a window may safely receive input: enumerate top-level windows, match the selector, judge visibility/minimized/cloaked/disabled/responding, then focus and read the foreground window back to confirm.

description.zh: 聚焦**验证过**而不是假设过：调完 SetForegroundWindow 会回读真实前台窗口，只有真的变成目标才返回成功；失败时点名当前占着前台的是谁。调用前先 AttachThreadInput 把当前前台线程的输入队列接上，让这次调用合法——不注入任何按键（实测：不接输入队列时三次温和尝试全败，退出码 5，前台是别的进程；接上后同一条命令退出码 0）。
description.en: Focus that is verified rather than assumed: after SetForegroundWindow it reads the real foreground window back and only succeeds if the target got it; a failure names whoever holds the foreground. Before the call it attaches our input queue to the foreground thread, which makes the call legal and injects no keys (measured: without attaching, three gentle attempts failed with exit 5 while another process held the foreground; with it, the same command exits 0).

description.zh: 聚焦并返回是否真的成功。
description.en: Focuses and reports whether it really worked.

description.zh: 当前是否就是前台窗口。
description.en: Whether the window is foreground right now.

description.zh: 注入前的全部客观判定：隐藏拒绝、最小化拒绝（除非 --allow-restore）、DWM 遮盖拒绝、被禁用拒绝（WS_DISABLED 会吞掉输入）、WM_NULL 无响应拒绝。判定结论带问题清单与备注，供 window inspect 展示。
description.en: Every objective check before injection: refuse hidden, minimized (unless --allow-restore), DWM-cloaked, disabled windows, and windows that fail the WM_NULL round trip. The verdict carries problem and note lists for `window inspect`.

description.zh: 给出可用性结论及理由。
description.en: Returns the usability verdict with reasons.

description.zh: 一次解析的完整结果：桌面全部窗口、选择器匹配者、参与收敛的候选、闸门通过者与逐个被拒的理由。一次枚举供给后续所有判定与错误文案使用。
description.en: The full result of one resolution: every window, the matches, the candidates that took part, the survivors, and why the rest were rejected. One enumeration feeds every later check and message.

description.zh: 解析并判定一个选择器。
description.en: Resolves and judges one selector.

description.zh: 把「--title/--class/--process/--pid/--hwnd」翻译成一组窗口：枚举 → 逐条件 AND 匹配 → 必要时回显候选表或提示。
description.en: Turns a selector into a set of windows: enumerate, match every condition with AND, and show candidate tables or hints when nothing matches.

description.zh: 用 EnumWindows 拿全部顶层窗口，跳过句柄无效的项；也可选地对每个窗口做一次 WM_NULL 探测（只有 window list 与最终候选需要）。
description.en: Walks every top-level window with EnumWindows, skipping invalid handles, optionally probing each one with WM_NULL (only `window list` and the final candidates need that).

description.zh: 枚举全部顶层窗口快照。
description.en: Enumerates snapshots of every top-level window.

description.zh: 枚举一次+过滤一次，返回全部匹配（不在这里选一个）——歧义交给上层报错并要求 --pick。
description.en: One enumeration, one filter, returning every match; picking among them is left to the caller, which refuses and asks for --pick instead of guessing.

description.zh: 返回匹配选择器的全部窗口。
description.en: Returns every window matching the selector.

description.zh: --hwnd 接受 0x 前缀或十进制，解析后校验窗口仍存在；非法输入给出可读错误而不是抛异常。
description.en: --hwnd accepts hex with a 0x prefix or decimal, checks the window still exists, and reports a readable error for bad input instead of throwing.

description.zh: 解析 --hwnd（0x 或十进制）。
description.en: Parses --hwnd as hex or decimal.

description.zh: 选择器没匹配到窗口时，附上当前可见窗口样例让用户对照——复用已枚举的列表，不重新扫一遍桌面。
description.en: When a selector matches nothing, appends a sample of the visible windows for the user to compare against, reusing the enumeration already in hand.

description.zh: 生成“没有匹配”的错误文案。
description.en: Builds the no-match error message.

description.zh: 各条件的 AND 组合：标题子串/完全匹配大小写不敏感，类名与进程名精确匹配，进程号与句柄直接比数值；空选择器不匹配任何窗口（宁可报错也不默认“当前窗口”）。
description.en: AND of every condition: title substring or exact match, case-insensitive; class and process compared exactly; pid and handle numerically. An empty selector matches nothing - better an error than a silent guess.

description.zh: 判断一个窗口是否满足全部条件。
description.en: Whether a window satisfies every condition.

description.zh: 把选择器渲染成可读文本。
description.en: Renders the selector as readable text.

description.zh: 回答“这个屏幕坐标下是哪个窗口”与“这个点是否落在客户区内”——前者用于 --strict-point，后者用于拦截落在窗口装饰上的客户区坐标。

description.zh: 每个窗口一份惰性快照：标题/类名/进程号一开始就读，可见性/最小化/遮盖/属主/矩形/进程名则首次读取时才从句柄现取并缓存。一条带选择器的命令要枚举近 400 个窗口，这个惰性设计把每窗 12 次 API 降到 4 次（实测 439ms → 3ms）。
description.en: One lazy snapshot per window: title, class and pid are read up front; visibility, minimized, cloaked, owner, rect and process name are resolved from the handle on first read and cached. Enumerating ~400 windows per targeted command drops from a dozen API calls each to four.

reading.zh: 一次调用的路径：入口解析目标与动作 → 脚本引擎（文本批量）或流程执行器（JSON 回放）→ 窗口识别与闸门 → 感知出口（读屏幕，只报告；也可以先让人用鼠标框一块）→ 输入注入 → 原生互操作。录制从另一端进入这条链（钩子 → JSON 流程）；编辑器是图形前端，取区域与回放都通过常驻 Runner；CLI 既能一次性执行，也能驱动同一个 Runner（runner 子命令）。
reading.en: One invocation flows left to right: the entry resolves target and action, then either the text script runner or the JSON flow runner, then the window layer, then perception (which only reports, or lets a human draw the region), then injection, then native syscalls. Recording enters the chain from the other end (hooks -> JSON flow); the editor is a graphical front end whose picking and replay go through the resident Runner, and the CLI can either run once or drive that same Runner.

title.zh: 运行时（一条命令的一次执行）

reading.zh: 三个项目对应三层（另有编辑器项目），构建脚本产出 dist 里的单文件，CI 与发布工作流把它们串起来。
reading.en: Three projects for three layers (plus the editor project), the build script produces the single file in dist, and the CI and release workflows chain them together.

reading.zh: 先是入口的三条路由（serve / runner / flow edit / 其余交给能力层），然后是全局选项与帮助，最后是各组命令自己的一层。
reading.en: First the entry with its three routes (serve / runner / flow edit / everything else to the capability layer), then the global options and help, then one layer per command group.

reading.zh: 从最简单到最复杂：敲一下 → 单独按下/松开 → 多键组合 → 整段文本（后者绕过输入法逐字注入 Unicode）。
reading.en: From simplest to richest: tap, separate press/release, chords, then whole strings typed as Unicode one character at a time.

reading.zh: 由只读到动手：先查坐标，再移动，然后按键与滚轮，最后是拖拽；右下角的坐标换算供全组共用（客户区坐标必须先换成屏幕坐标）。
reading.en: From read-only to acting: query, move, click and scroll, then drag. The geometry unit is shared by the whole group, since client coordinates must be mapped before anything can be clicked.

reading.zh: 先看后动：list 列出桌面、inspect 解释某个窗口为何可用/不可用；右侧是真正会改变状态的聚焦路径，也是脚本设定当前目标的方式。
reading.en: Look before you leap: list and inspect explain the desktop; on the right is the path that actually changes state, and how a script sets its current target.

reading.zh: 两件互不相干的小事：写出去时用什么编码，排表时按什么宽度。两件都只在中文终端上才看得出差别。
reading.en: Two unrelated concerns: which encoding goes out, and which width the tables are padded to. Both only show up on a Chinese console.

reading.zh: 阅读顺序：先概览，再按需下钻到命令参考 / 设计取舍 / 开发与发布流程，最后是可直接跑的示例脚本。
reading.en: Read the overview first, then drill into the reference, the design rationale or the process; the sample script is the runnable version of all of it.

reading.zh: 外壳把步骤列表与检查器摆好，一切编辑写进视图模型；取区域与回放都通过桥接走常驻 Runner（命名管道），编辑器自己不认识流程格式细节、也不重做选区与回放，schema 直接引用能力层。
reading.en: The shell lays out the step list and the inspector, edits go into the view model, and both region picking and replay go through the bridge to the resident Runner over the named pipe: the editor re-does neither picking nor replay, and the schema comes straight from the capability layer.

reading.zh: 先看"文档与编译器"，再看"执行计划与变量帧"（内联与作用域都在这里），最后是"执行器"（按帧跑并上报）。
reading.en: Read the document and compiler first, then the execution plan (inlining and scope), then the runner.

reading.zh: 所有事件都从左侧的 send 出口一次性投递（按下→移动→抬起必须同批，否则会被系统重排）；右侧六块是各类事件的构造器。
reading.en: Every event leaves through send on the left, in one ordered batch; the six units on the right build the individual event shapes.

reading.zh: 全都是 P/Invoke 声明与薄封装，不含业务判断：枚举与读取窗口信息、查状态与矩形、取像、聚焦与层级、专项查询、输入 API；右下的钩子层负责全局键鼠观察（录制用）。
reading.en: Pure P/Invoke declarations and thin wrappers, no business judgement: enumerate and read windows, query state and geometry, capture pixels, foreground and layer calls, specialised queries, input APIs - plus the hook layer that observes global input for recording.

reading.zh: 两条路共用一套换算：浮层只负责把人画出来的屏幕矩形交出来；把它翻译成 probe 认得的坐标系、并给出可粘贴的命令，由 placement 的一条规则决定（客户区 → 窗口 → 无）。
reading.en: Both paths share one conversion: the overlay only hands over the screen rectangle a human drew; turning it into a space probe accepts, and printing a paste-ready command, is placement single rule (client, then window, then nothing).

reading.zh: 钩子把事件交给会话，会话把事件流合成步骤并写成流程文件：抽稀、配对、解析窗口都在会话里，钩子层只管"看到了什么"。
reading.en: The hooks hand events to the session, which synthesises steps and writes the flow file: thinning, pairing and window resolution all live in the session; the hook layer only reports what it saw.

reading.zh: 协议定义形状，作业把形状变成"能暂停、能取消、能报告"的执行，管道把两者接上网线；四者合起来就是一个本地服务。
reading.en: The protocol defines the shape, a job turns that shape into an execution that can pause, cancel and report, and the pipe puts both on the wire; together they are one local service.

reading.zh: 一次 run 的四段：入口与选项（读什么、怎么跑）→ 静态分析（分词、循环结构、变量作用域、目标继承）→ 执行（逐条派发、输出捕获、重试）→ 产物（JSON 报告）。静态分析组里任何错误都会在任何命令执行之前带行号报出。
reading.en: The four stages of one run: entry and options, static analysis (tokenising, loop structure, variable scopes, target inheritance), execution (dispatch, capture, retry), and the artefacts. Anything wrong in the analysis stage fails with a line number before a single command runs.

reading.zh: 先解析每个 repeat 头（次数与循环变量名），再扫一遍全脚本得出包围关系、配对表与展开总数——结构不合法就在这里终止，命令一条都还没跑。
reading.en: Parse each loop header first, then a single pass yields the enclosing relations, matching ends and the expansion count; an illegal structure stops here, before any command runs.

reading.zh: 先分行（保留行号，供所有错误信息定位），再逐行分词成 argv。
reading.en: Split into numbered lines first, then tokenise each into argv.

reading.zh: 四段流水：先读入+全量静态校验（一条命令都不跑），再逐条派发，然后输出进度，最后汇总与写报告。前三段都不改变外部世界，除了派发段。
reading.en: Four stages: read and fully validate (running nothing), dispatch line by line, print progress, then summarise and write the report. Only the dispatch stage touches the outside world.

reading.zh: 每行先抽出目标选项，再判断这条命令要不要继承当前目标（只有 mouse/key 会）。
reading.en: Each line first yields its target options; then the rule decides whether the command inherits the current target - only mouse and key do.

reading.zh: 左侧是执行前的全量校验（为了让 typo 在任何命令之前失败），右侧是执行时真正的替换（循环变量每轮不同，所以替换必须逐行做）。
reading.en: The left side checks every reference before anything runs so a typo cannot surface halfway; the right side does the substitution at execution time, because a loop variable changes each iteration.

reading.zh: 解析出选择器与超时参数，然后按固定间隔重复断言直到满足或超时。
reading.en: Parse the selector and timeouts, then repeat the assertion at a fixed interval until it holds or time runs out.

reading.zh: 分两层：上面是不需要桌面的（单元测试、基准、文档链接——CI 能跑），下面是需要真实桌面的（冒烟、它的靶子窗口，以及把一次测量完整留档的证据脚本）。
reading.en: Two tiers: the desktop-free checks CI can run (unit suite, benchmark, docs links), and the desktop-only ones - the smoke suite, the target window it drives, and the evidence archive that keeps a whole measurement run.

reading.zh: 从入口往下看：先语法与选项，再到脚本语义，最后两组是保护 v2 不变量的（循环与继承、单进程派发）。
reading.en: Top to bottom: entry, then syntax and options, then script semantics, and finally the two sets that protect the v2 invariants - loops/inheritance, and single-process dispatch.

reading.zh: 两组用例并列，各自护着一条 v2 不变量：循环的结构合法性、目标继承的边界（谁继承、谁不继承）。
reading.en: Two case sets side by side, each guarding one v2 invariant: that loop structure is valid before anything runs, and the exact boundary of target inheritance.

reading.zh: 从“哪些窗口”到“能不能用”：选择与匹配 → 快照属性 → 闸门逐项判定 → 聚焦并回读前台。最下方的 resolve 把前四步串成一次解析，供每条命令复用。
reading.en: From which windows to whether one is usable: select and match, snapshot the facts, run the gate, focus and read the foreground back. resolve at the bottom strings those together for every command.

reading.zh: 枚举整个桌面 → 按条件过滤 → 用句柄或屏幕点定位；右侧两块只在出错时出面（候选表与“没有匹配”提示）。
reading.en: Enumerate the desktop, filter by the selector, or locate by handle or screen point; the two on the right only appear when something goes wrong.
